title: Numerical study of shrouded contra-rotating propellers.
author: Halyson Henrique de Souza Valadăo
abstract: The main goal of this work, developed in the Laboratory of Aerodynamics and Propulsion of SUPAERO, was the analysis of the influence of certain parameters on the axial thrust and boundary layer of a shrouded contra-rotating motor. The parameters are: the geometry, using three main geometries; the mass flow, using the same ranges of the experimental data; the viscosity, comparing the inviscid flow and the viscous one; and the mesh refinement. The simulations were all numerical, using a CFD program. The results obtained were studied to understand the pressure and velocity fields around the shroud.
